meta.title: Byteex - Don't apologize for being comfortable.
meta.description: Consciously made butter soft staples for every day (or night). Beautiful, comfortable loungewear, ethically sourced and responsibly made.

bullets.text: Beautiful, comfortable loungewear for day or night.
No wasteful extras, like tags or plastic packaging.
Our signature fabric is incredibly comfortable — unlike anything you've ever felt.

review.name: Amy P.
review.text: Overjoyed with my Loungewear set. I have the jogger and the sweatshirt. Quality product on every level. From the compostable packaging, to the supplied washing bag, even the garments smells like fresh herbs when I first held them.
